name: Uki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uki city emblem in orange, light blue and green: an orange disc between light blue and green leaf-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Uki, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 January 2005.
